description: I am adding a basement secondary suite inside my two-storey detached house with a building area of 160 m2. The only dwellings will be the main home and that suite. Each dwelling will have interconnected smoke alarms internally, but I want no connection between the two sets, wireless or wired. I do not want an alarm in one dwelling to sound in the other.
known_facts: detached house with one internal secondary suite
smoke alarms interconnected within each dwelling only
no wireless or hard-wired cross-house interconnection

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: Smoke alarms are not interconnected throughout the house with a secondary suite.

should_cite.why: Within-unit interconnection does not replace the secondary-suite house-wide requirement.

gold.engineering_reason: The house is within the residential exemption, with secondary suites excluded from the dwelling count; an AHJ special-safety requirement remains possible.
